name: Bvlgari Resort Bali
positioning: Clifftop villa resort on the southern coast of the Bukit peninsula, officially Bvlgari Resort Bali, with Italian-Balinese architecture and private-pool villas
best_for: Travelers who want a private-pool villa with butler service
Guests who want on-site yoga and a spa

facts.text: The resort sits on a limestone clifftop along the southern coast of the Bukit peninsula.
The accommodation consists of villas and mansions with private pools and bespoke butler service.
The Bvlgari Villa has a heated swimming pool that reaches toward the Indian Ocean and cascades into a second lower pool.
The Five-Bedroom Mansions have a dedicated separate entrance and sit in tropical gardens with ocean vistas.
The Bvlgari Spa menu combines Asian and European approaches, including an ayurvedic Balinese ritual, facials, body wraps and Balinese massages.
Private yoga instruction is available around the clock.
Local village walks are among the complimentary experiences offered.
The resort offers flexible check-in and check-out, depending on availability.
La Spiaggia is a multi-level cafe above the beach serving a lunchtime menu.
The grounds include a helicopter pad.
The Kecak Fire Dance at Uluwatu Temple is a 15-minute drive from the resort.

highlights.text: Breakfast is available 24 hours a day, served in the villa at no extra charge or at the all-day restaurant Sangkar.
The design uses local materials such as blackened Javanese mahogany, alang-alang thatch and sukabami stone.
Il Ristorante - Nico Romito serves tasting menus in the evening.
The spa entrance is an antique Javanese joglo house, and the spa area includes a yoga sala, a fitness center and a second swimming pool.
Serpenti Beach is protected by a coral reef and is inaccessible to the general public from ground and sea.

considerations.text: There is no kids club, but activities such as kite-making and Balinese dance are available on request, and babysitting is available.
WhataHotel notes the location is secluded and away from main tourist areas.
